DIRECT TO RADIO · NO ODMASTER ACCOUNT

TIDRADIO TD-H9.
Bluetooth programmer.

H9 Toolbox connects to your TIDRADIO TD-H9 over Bluetooth so you can edit channels and radio settings in Chrome or Edge. Import and export channel CSV files, transfer readable JSON configurations, and save a full .img backup. No account is required. Radio data stays in your browser; visits and site interactions on h9toolbox.com are measured with Google Analytics.

TD-H9 owners have successfully used H9 Toolbox on several radios.

Radio settings

0 loaded

Inspect and edit documented radio, Bluetooth, GNSS, and APRS options from the full backup. Open a group to see its controls. Unknown values remain unchanged unless you select a new value.

Read from the radio or open a backup to inspect its settings.

Fixed GNSS coordinates, stored DTMF codes, FM broadcast presets, and undocumented firmware bytes remain in the backup and are not edited here. Changing APRS beacon or relay options can cause transmissions; review those values before writing.

    About programming the TIDRADIO TD-H9

    Which browsers support Bluetooth programming?

    Use Chrome or Edge on a computer with Bluetooth and open this site over HTTPS. Enable Bluetooth programming mode on the TD-H9 before connecting. Web Bluetooth is not supported in iPhone Safari.

    Can I edit channels without connecting a radio?

    Yes. Open a previously saved TD-H9 .img backup or a lossless JSON archive to work offline. You can edit channels and mapped settings, import or export channel CSV files, and download the working .img. Writing changes to a radio requires a Bluetooth connection.

    Which channel settings can I change?

    Edit receive and transmit frequencies, channel names, FM or AM modulation, bandwidth, CTCSS and DCS tones, transmit power, scan inclusion, and other mapped channel options for channels 1–199. The radio settings editor also covers mapped display, button, Bluetooth, GNSS, and APRS options. Undocumented bytes are preserved.

    Do I need an account, and where is my radio data stored?

    No account or ODmaster login is needed. Radio images, channels, and settings stay in browser memory unless you download them. Google Analytics measures visits and site interactions on h9toolbox.com, but does not receive radio images, channels, or settings.

    Should I save a backup before writing changes?

    Yes. Keep an untouched .img backup so you can return to your original configuration. Review your channels and settings before writing. H9 Toolbox checks the radio against the original image, writes only changed blocks, and reads each changed block back to verify it.
